overview: The board endorsed a lot division for 7 Grant Avenue and received updates regarding city-wide zoning changes and the drafting of new design guidelines. The meeting also included the introduction of a new associate member and the approval of several months of past meeting minutes.

items.title: New Member Introduction and Procedural Matters
items.summary: The board introduced new associate alternate member Ben Lavallee and established remote meeting procedures.

items.title: Approval Not Required: 7 Grant Avenue
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) plan to divide a 9,500-square-foot lot into two parcels, with the understanding that the second lot will require a zoning variance for size before development.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from May 5, May 25, July 17, and August 7, 2024, subject to minor typo corrections.

items.title: Zoning and Design Guideline Updates
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt reported on progress regarding green scores and incentive zoning, recommending that new design guidelines be adopted directly by the board to maintain flexibility. Drafts of these Medford-specific guidelines and zoning recommendations are expected from consultants in September.

items.title: Informal Project Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the opening of the Great American Beer Hall, highlighting the success of required bike parking and the developer's commitment to solar energy installations.
